Question 7
?

Consider the function F(x,y,z)=(yzexz+z)i+(exz+1)j+(xyexz+x)k. Find f(x,y,z) such that ∇f(x,y,z)=F(x,y,z).

a
f(x,y,z)=yexz+yz+x+C
b
f(x,y,z)=yexz+xy+z+C
c
f(x,y,z)=yexz+xz+y+C
d
f(x,y,z)=xzexz+xz+C
e
f(x,y,z)=xzexz+y+C
